title: epipactis leptochila var. savelliana
intro: Epipactis leptochila var. savelliana, commonly known as Savell's helleborine, is a type of orchid plant belonging to the family Orchidaceae. The plant is known for its potential health benefits, including its antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory properties, which can help to reduce inflammation and fight off infections. The therapeutic actions of Savell's helleborine include its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant, making it a potential candidate for treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include iridoids and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its therapeutic properties.
